data.name: confirm-email.Subject
data.value: Confirm your email for {GridName}

data.name: confirm-email.Body
data.value:
Hello {AvatarName},
Please confirm your email address for {GridName}:
{Link}
The link works once, for {ExpiresIn}. If you didn't sign up, you can ignore this email.

data.name: reset-password.Subject
data.value: Reset your {GridName} password

data.name: reset-password.Body
data.value:
Hello {AvatarName},
Someone asked to reset your password on {GridName}. To choose a new one, open this link:
{Link}
The link works once, for {ExpiresIn}. If it wasn't you, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

data.name: account-approved.Subject
data.value: Welcome to {GridName}

data.name: account-approved.Body
password-changed.Subject
data.value: Your password on {GridName} was changed

data.name: password-changed.Body
data.value:
Hello {AvatarName},
Your password on {GridName} was just changed, and you were signed out everywhere.
If it wasn't you, contact the grid owner straight away.

data.name: already-have-account.Subject
data.value: Someone tried to sign up on {GridName}

data.name: already-have-account.Body
data.value:
Hello {AvatarName},
Someone tried to sign up on {GridName} with this email address. If that was you, you already have an avatar: {AvatarName}.
Forgot your password? You can choose a new one here:
{Link}
If it wasn't you, you can ignore this email.

data.name: confirm-new-email.Subject
data.value: Confirm your new email address

data.name: confirm-new-email.Body
data.value:
Hello {AvatarName},
Confirm your new email address for {AvatarName} on {GridName}:
{Link}
The link works once, for {ExpiresIn}. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email.

data.name: email-change-notice.Subject
data.value: Your email address on {GridName}

data.name: email-change-notice.Body
data.value:
Hello {AvatarName},
Someone asked to change the email address for {AvatarName} on {GridName}. If that was you, there's nothing to do.
If not, change your password now:
{Link}

data.name: signup-denied.Subject
data.value: Your sign-up on {GridName}

data.name: signup-denied.Body
name-changed.Subject
data.value: Your name on {GridName} was changed

data.name: name-changed.Body
data.value:
Hello {AvatarName},
Staff on {GridName} changed your avatar's name from {OldName} to {AvatarName}. Log in with the new name from now on. Your friends, groups, inventory and regions stay as they were.
If you didn't ask for this, contact the grid owner.

data.name: email-changed-by-staff.Subject
data.value: Your email address on {GridName} was changed

data.name: email-changed-by-staff.Body
data.value:
Hello {AvatarName},
Staff on {GridName} changed the email address for {AvatarName}, so emails from the grid no longer come here.
If you didn't ask for this, contact the grid owner, and choose a new password:
{Link}

data.name: email-set-by-staff.Subject
data.value: Your email address on {GridName}

data.name: email-set-by-staff.Body
data.value:
Hello {AvatarName},
Staff on {GridName} set this as the email address for {AvatarName}. Password resets and notices from the grid come here from now on.
If you don't know {AvatarName}, you can ignore this email.

data.name: staff-reset-password.Subject
data.value: Choose a new password for {GridName}

data.name: staff-reset-password.Body
data.value:
Hello {AvatarName},
Staff on {GridName} sent you this link to choose a new password:
{Link}
The link works once, for {ExpiresIn}. When you set the new password, two-factor sign-in is turned off for your account, and you can turn it on again from your account page. If you didn't ask staff for this, ignore this email: nothing changes.

data.name: takedown-removed.Body

data.value: Items put back in your {GridName} inventory

data.name: takedown-restored.Body
ticket-confirm.Subject
data.value: Confirm your {GridName} support ticket

data.name: ticket-confirm.Body
data.value:
Hello {Name},
You (or someone using this address) sent a support ticket to {GridName}: "{Subject}". To send it to staff, open this link within 24 hours:
{Link}
If you didn't send it, ignore this email and the ticket is deleted.

data.name: ticket-access.Subject
data.value: Your {GridName} support ticket {TicketNumber}

data.name: ticket-access.Body
data.value:
Hello {Name},
Your ticket {TicketNumber} ("{Subject}") is with {GridName}'s staff. Read their answers and reply here:
{Link}
The link works for 30 days. Keep it private: anyone with it can read your ticket.

data.name: ticket-staff-reply.Subject
data.value: {GridName} staff answered your ticket {TicketNumber}

data.name: ticket-staff-reply.Body
data.value:
Hello {Name},
Staff answered your ticket {TicketNumber} ("{Subject}"). Read the answer and reply here:
{Link}
The link works for 30 days. Keep it private: anyone with it can read your ticket.
